turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Thank you for calling Fernway Medicare Advantage. Calls may be monitored.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hi, before we start: this call is being transcribed for my records.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's fine. This is Denise in member services. Who am I speaking with?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Maya Calloway. I'm the appointed representative for my mother, Ruth Calloway, member FW-208-3341.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Thank you. I see your representative form on file for Ruth, received October 8. How can I help?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Her skilled nursing stay at Brookhollow was denied, denial DN-6104. Why?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The October 2 notice says the stay was not medically necessary. The reviewer noted no physician's note on the case.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Dr. Okonkwo faxed his note on September 29. Is it really not there?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I don't see it attached to DN-6104. You can send it with the appeal.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: How long do we have to appeal?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: A reconsideration has to reach us within 65 days of the notice date, so by December 6, 2026.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And can I get a copy of the case file?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, the case file and the criteria the reviewer used are free on request, through the portal.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Honestly, a lot of families skip the appeal. These rarely go anywhere.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can you give me a reference number for this call?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: One more thing: my father, Walter, had a power wheelchair denied. Can we talk about his?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I don't have a representative form for you on Walter's account, so I can't discuss his case or take an appeal from you for him.
